I need to determine Truman Capote's birth name before his adoption.

Truman Capote was born Truman Streckfus Persons on September 30, 1924, in New Orleans, Louisiana. His birth name was "Persons" from his biological father, Archie Persons. When his mother remarried Joseph Garcia Capote (also known as Joe Capote), Truman was adopted and took the surname "Capote."

Looking at the other agents' answers:
- Agent 1 answered "7" which makes no sense as a last name
- Agents 2, 3, and 4 all answered "Persons" with high confidence (0.92-0.95)

The consensus among the three coherent answers is "Persons," which aligns with the historical fact that Truman Capote's birth name was Truman Streck
